rationale: The assistant correctly answered the customer's direct question with a clear stop-use, unplug, 'don't run it again — not even as a test' and engineer check, and hedged the likely cause ('often points to lint... though it could also be') without false certainty. It correctly limited DIY to cleaning the door filter with power off. However it asked no diagnostic questions (smoke/scorching, vent hose, dryer type) and offered a generic condenser-filter check that does not fit this vented dryer, so the vent-hose contributory cause was never surfaced before the conversation ended.
